claim: The same individual fibroblasts returned toward baseline after withdrawal.
passage: Bulk RNA sequencing was performed on fresh aliquots at each visit. Individual cells were not tracked across time. The donor-average RNA profile moved closer to baseline after withdrawal.

claim: The donor-average RNA profile moved closer to baseline after withdrawal.
passage: Bulk RNA sequencing was performed on fresh aliquots at each visit. Individual cells were not tracked across time. The donor-average RNA profile moved closer to baseline after withdrawal.

claim: The same individual fibroblasts returned toward baseline after withdrawal.
passage: Live-cell imaging tracked the same individual fibroblasts over time. For each tracked cell, its reporter signal moved closer to its own baseline after withdrawal.

claim: The same individual cells recovered after treatment.
passage: Samples from three donors were collected before and after treatment. Average reporter signal increased; no cell-identification methods are described in this excerpt.

claim: The authors did not track the same individual cells over time.
passage: The authors did not track the same individual cells over time. Each bulk sample was collected from a different aliquot.

claim: The same cell type was present at both visits.
passage: The same cell type was present at both visits. We profiled fresh cells from each donor at each visit.

claim: The same individual cells regained their original expression state.
passage: A single-cell RNA-sequencing dataset was collected at each time point. Cells were destroyed during measurement and different cells were sampled at each time point. The subset frequencies were similar.

claim: Each donor's methylation at one locus moved closer to baseline.
passage: For each of three donors, methylation at the target locus was closer to baseline after withdrawal than it was during treatment. The measurements were bulk averages.

claim: The same individual cells recovered after treatment.
passage: For live imaging, we tracked the same individual cells over time. For the sequencing experiment, individual cells were not tracked across time. The report does not specify which experiment produced the recovery result.

claim: The same individual cells recovered after treatment.
passage: Lineage barcodes linked related descendants to their shared clone. Clone-average fluorescence returned to baseline. No method for identifying the identical cell at both visits is described.

claim: The same individual cells regained their baseline reporter signal.
passage: We tracked the same individual cells over time with time-lapse microscopy. For every tracked cell, reporter signal returned to its own baseline by the final frame.

claim: Mean reporter signal rose in the final sample.
passage: Mean reporter signal rose in the final sample. Bulk lysates were used for this comparison.
